items.ruling: KEEP admission's ValueError('Operation has no pull backend capability contract'). Do NOT change admission, do NOT add Ray-only ops to the pull whitelist, do NOT special-case their error message. A-U01's tests pinning the real in-tree ValueError are CORRECT and need no change. The coordinator-named UnsupportedExecutionOptionError criterion was WRONG: it came from the main repo (IL012 trap), not from A's tree. Coordinator error, not an A implementation defect.
authority: tasks/A007.md:44 explicitly lists ValueError as a legal error type alongside UnsupportedExecutionOptionError and RecoveryContractError -> admission raising ValueError is IN contract, not a deviation.

CONTRACTS.md:73 mandates UnsupportedExecutionOptionError ONLY for 'local receives Ray-only native_options'. SortOp is not native_options. admit_action_plan's native_options branch already raises it correctly.
